{{Quote|The grudge goes back to an incident in the Dalcretti system, when both team captains were members of an Imperial Army unit cut off by Rebel insurgents.|A news report included in the fiftieth-anniversary edition of ''Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology''|<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>}}
The '''Dalcretti system''' was situated in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and lay on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] linked it to the [[Taanab system/Legends|Taanab]] and [[Tirahnn system/Legends|Tirahnn systems]] and served as the dividing line between the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] regions.<ref name="TEA" />

According to rumors, during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]<ref name="Galladinium" /> and between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="Dates">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', which mentions the [[Battle of the Dalcretti system|incident in the Dalcretti system]] as having occurred at least two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior, is set during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> an [[Battle of the Dalcretti system|incident]] occurred in the Dalcretti [[Star system/Legends|system]] in which [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] insurgents cut off a unit of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]]. One of the unit's members, [[Demelza Mintori]], supposedly failed to render assistance to the [[Platoon/Legends|platoon]] of fellow [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Madrix Hansor]], leading the latter to swear vengeance against Mintori. The enmity between the two carried on to when both became team captains in the [[Core Gladiator Walker League]] and continued for at least two [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. The Dalcretti system's rumored role in the feud was eventually noted in a news report that was included in the [[Galladinium's 50th anniversary edition|fiftieth-anniversary edition]] of ''[[Galladinium's Galactic Datalog of Fantastic Technology]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dalcretti system was first mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square O-8.<ref name="TEA" />
